name: Data on the Device: Offline, Sync and Conflicts
summary: The network is optional and the app is not. Local storage, an offline-first architecture, a synchronisation that resumes, and the conflict two devices will always eventually create.
prerequisites: Requires an app that already reads from an API — this is about what happens when that API is not there. Any of the three platforms: the examples come from all of them.
syllabus: What lives on the device, and the sandbox it lives in

Synchronisation: queue, retry, idempotency and deltas
Conflicts: last write wins, versioning and CRDTs
Encryption on the device, and the data that should not be there
